subject: English
passage: Independent record labels emerged in the 1960s as an alternative to major corporate record companies, allowing musicians to produce albums that were more unconventional than typical mainstream releases. One such musician was composer Sun Ra. Working with independent labels enabled Sun Ra not only to record his own compositions but also to experiment with unusual arrangements and sounds, regardless of how avant-garde the results might have seemed to audiences familiar with commercial jazz. In this way, Sun Ra ______
prompt: Which choice most logically completes the text?

choices.A: created albums that would have been too controversial to release if a major label had controlled the recording process.
choices.B: discovered that working with an independent label was more time-consuming than working with a major label.
choices.C: exemplifies the creative freedom provided by independent record labels.
choices.D: would have sold more records if he had composed music that was mainstream instead of experimental.

explanation:
Choice C is the best answer. The text says that independent record labels allowed musicians to produce more unconventional albums, and then discusses how Sun Ra was free to experiment with unusual arrangements and sounds. This suggests that Sun Ra exemplifies the creative freedom offered by independent labels.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect. This inference isn't supported. The text never discusses the time requirements of working with different types of labels, so there's no basis to make this inference.
